messages:
marta: Quick heads-up — thinking of sliding the next release window up by one day (from Fri 26 to Thu 25) to avoid EU holiday overlap. Anyone blocked by that?

devon: FYI, our branch cut won't be ready until EOD Thu unless we accelerate QA. Can we move the branch cutoff to 12:00 UTC Thu?

yu: I can push the v1.12.0 bump change today. Will need someone to review changelog + release notes.

alex: I'll review changelog after standup. @marta do we need to open a canary for mobile or will it affect smoke tests?

ci-bot: CI: nightly-build passed on feature/release-bump (sha: a1b2c3) — 2/2 jobs succeeded.

marta: Great. @devon please open a PR with `branch-cutoff` tag and add 'hold-until: 2025-03-25T12:00Z' in description. Also add checklist: `smoke, perf, docs`.

devon: Done: https://git.example.com/redwood/release/PR-1234 — tag added. Also added a script snippet to help local QA:
```bash
grade_release.sh --smoke --perf
```

alex: Saw the PR. Left minor nit on changelog formatting. :pencil2: Also pinging @release-manager for SLA/maintenance window alignment.

release-manager: We have a maintenance blackout Fri 26 00:00-06:00 UTC due to infra upgrades. Moving to Thu 25 is fine. I'll update calendar and notify SRE.

yu: I'll merge bump once PR approved. Any objection to skipping canary on mobile to save time? Mobile team OK w/ rollback plan.

alex: Mobile agreed to skip canary if we have fast rollback. Add a fallback policy in Console (route: mobile -> v1.11 fallback).

marta: Okay. Finalizing: branch cut: Thu 25 12:00 UTC; release window Thu 25 18:00 UTC; changelog + PR review by 15:00 UTC. I'll update the release calendar. :calendar:
